items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: That was the guy in Topeka who heard of a guy needing a saxophone player out in Minot... he sent me a telegram that said he had a job for me out in Minot... But that was my first band.

ctx.x: Now, what was the first group that you ...(?)..., Foots?
Well, this guy in Topeka named Overstreet...
